title: Concept: Liveness check score disclosed
description: A liveness score or threshold field in a response hands every reader the view the build or admin side kept: The score tells an attacker how close a spoof came to passing, which is exactly the feedback needed to tune a presentation attack until it clears the threshold.
applicability: Deployments that render a liveness score or threshold field into a customer- or partner-facing response.
risk: The score tells an attacker how close a spoof came to passing, which is exactly the feedback needed to tune a presentation attack until it clears the threshold.
